summary.text: Samantha Derenthal is the Democratic, Working Families Party and Independent Party of Connecticut candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 44, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she is running against incumbent Anne Dauphinais (R).
Ballotpedia lists her as an at-large member of the Plainfield School District board.

paragraphs.text: Derenthal ran for the same seat in 2024 as a Democrat and Independent Party of Connecticut candidate, losing to Dauphinais 63.3 percent to 36.7 percent (6,982 votes to 4,041).
On her campaign website, Derenthal says she is running on affordability, access to health care, strong local jobs and smart growth that preserves small-town character.
She also writes that education is a top priority, including fully funding schools and supporting special education and mental health resources.
Ballotpedia lists the Connecticut AFL-CIO among her 2026 endorsements.
